book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: N'yɛyɛ wu Jiso kune kimbefɛ bɛ mbɛmɛ mo lɛme
Jiso jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ mwɛɛ mù tele bamii fɛ bo gêe kimbefɛ nyu njɛ mu lé mu nyû yu sɛŋ gɛ. Geenɛ, ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le fɛ muh wù tele lɛ bamii gêe bimbefɛ le.
Fi joŋe fɛ wu wɛɛ muh le lɛ ba shɛŋshɛ ki bwee ki jɛnɛ a kindoŋ ke le, ba tooŋsɛ wu a joo yì baaŋ le, fede fɛ wù gee booŋ banɛ gêe bimbefɛ.
Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ nyume bɛŋ yɛ̂ne. Mwa bwoo nɛ le wu ge fiɛɛ fì befe, wo jɛmɛ wu le. Wu nɛ le wu kusɛ, wo foosɛ wu.
Wu nɛ le wu ge mwɛɛ mù mbefe fɛ wo le, kiŋgane kinsooshwi yi juu le, wu kaasɛ wu to wu ku chiaaŋ lɛ wu le wu jiaa, tu wo kɛmɛ ki wo fôosɛ wu.”

content: Booŋ ba Tada ba ntuŋ ja bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Gee lɛ mbɛmɛ wese tɛɛme chuule.”

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, bɛŋ nɛ be kɛme mbɛmɛ wu le gɛh njɛ shaŋ yì nsuu, tu taŋlo bɛŋ du kite kì baaŋ kinɛ le lɛ ki mugɛ ye, fɛnɛ ki gɛɛŋ ki lɛɛŋ a joo yì baaŋ le, tu ki lé ki mo ki yû lo bɛŋ le.

Bɛŋ jo lɛ muh wu ŋgoo yɛne kɛmɛ mwa ye wu lɛme, wu she wu lɛne mwɛne, kɛnɛ wu be jiiŋe nyu fɛ shóŋ le, wu doo wu kwɛɛ, taŋlo wu mo wu du lɛ mwa ye wu lɛme wɛɛ gɛɛŋ lo wu jo mwɛɛ mwe munjile wu shii wu jii?

Gɛ taŋlo fi nyu noo gɛ. Fiɛɛ fì wu taŋlo wu du le gɛ lɛ wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu kûsɛ njú, wu sêesɛ mwɛɛ munjile mwe wu tô bɛ mu, wu mo wu chîɛɛne, wu doo wu jî mwɛɛ, wu muu, wu bânyɛ shú fɛ wu gɛ̂ɛŋ wu jîi mwe.
Mwa ye wu lɛme wɛɛ ge mwɛɛ munɛ munchii, wu she wu nyaa wu kiyone?
Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no fiena le. Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ ge wa lɛme chì ba gɛ̀ nya bɛŋ le chi ka, bɛŋ du lɛ, ‘Bee le gɛh lo fiesa booŋ ba lɛme, bee le be ge wa lɛme chesa.’”

content: Jiso fɛ bamii ba goŋ yì baaŋ yuufe
Jiso gɛ̀ gɛɛne Yɛlusalɛm, wu fede a kijwe ki woŋ wu Samaliya bɛ ki Galalee le.
Wu gɛ̀ gɛɛne wu doo wu leese ntɛ wumu le, bilɛŋsɛ bamu yuufe ba gɛ̀ chɛne bɛ goŋ yì baaŋ yɛŋ wu le bo nyu je yì ndefe le,
bo mo bo tɛɛŋ bɛ jɛ yi tɛɛme lɛ, “Jiso chiji kikwɛɛ, koo gɛh yii fɛ bee le.”
No Jiso yɛŋ bo le, wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ bɛŋ dûnyɛ ye yene bachiji kintanyɛ le.”

content: No bo ja bo gɛɛne bo mo bo tɛmɛ bo yuu bo baaŋ a je.
Muh mu a bo antɛnɛɛ yɛŋ lɛ wu le wu tɛmɛ wa, wu kaasɛ wu tu jiŋ fɛ Jiso le wu yuuse Nyo fɛwɛɛwe.
Noo, wu gɛɛŋ wu mo wu gwe a Jiso jii, wu nya wu kiyone. Muh wuyu gɛ̀ bee muh wu Samaliya.

content.text: “Bamii bee yuufe ba mbe nfɛ bo mo bo yuu, ba bvuugɛ le faane?
Fi le lɛ muh baaŋ nyu gɛ yu, wù yɛŋ lɛ wu lé wu kâasɛ wu tu jiŋ wu nya mbɛɛŋsɛ Nyo le fede ntolo wunɛ gɛ?”

content: Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Ja we wo gɛ̂ɛne fiuŋ. Fitele fì wo lese yi ye yaŋ le, le fi ge wa wo tɛmɛ.”

content: Bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo bvu mɛɛse bɛ bvu too
Bafalashii gɛ ja bo biih Jiso le laa bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo bvunɛ le bvu to sege la lɛ. Wu chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ njiŋɛ nyu yu wù lé wu gê wu dûnyɛ sege Nyo lé wu gê wu kɛ̂ wu sâge bvunfoŋ bwe bvunɛ gɛ.
Gɛ muh nyu yu wù lé wu gê wu dû lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, nɛ Nyo wunɛ wu sage fɛnɛ’, kɛnɛ lɛ, ‘Nɛ wu wege wu sage fɛge gɛ.’ Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le nyu a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ.”

content: Wu mo wu kaasɛ wu jɛmɛ wa nyu booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Kife too lo kì bɛŋ lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ gôone ki bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh le gɛh yi juu le chimimia, bɛŋ gɛ yɛŋ gɛ.

Lé gê nyû kife kɛɛ le bamii bamu duu lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, nɛ muh wege fɛge’, kɛnɛ lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, nɛ muh wunɛ fɛnɛ.’ Bo doo bo jɛme noo, keefɛ bɛŋ bîi bo le gɛ. Keefɛ bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛne bɛŋ biji gɛ.

Bɛŋ kee no jaŋ to yi lale we nɛ mwamwamwa, abu a woŋ a ana le achii yuu nɛ mwaaŋ, bamii bachii yɛŋ. Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no bamii bachii lé bo tô bo yɛ̂ŋ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh le juu chì wu kaase wu too.
Geenɛ, no wu lé wu gê wu gɛ̂ɛne, fɛ wu kaasɛ wu to, lé wu kɛ̂me ki wu yâ wu yɛ̂ŋ baŋgɛ ba duude kiŋgogɛ ki mɛɛse kinɛ faŋ wu.
Gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no fi gɛ̀ bee kife kì Nyua le, nyu gɛh no fi lé fi gê fi nyûme kife kì muh wù jee che le Mwamuh.
Bo gɛ̀ jii mwɛɛ, bo ka muu, bikɛse bɛ bilɛŋsɛ taashɛ bvuguu, bamii nyaa booŋ ba taashi bvuguu bɛ bo, gɛɛŋ bu juu chì Nyua gɛ̀ lesɛ a ŋguh le, joo gɛ̀ bu yi to yi lɛɛshɛ bo bachii.
Fi lé fi gê fi nyû tɛ gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no fi gɛ̀ bee kife ki Lod le. Bamii gɛ̀ jii mwɛɛ, bo muu, bo kame waaŋ, bo lɛne ŋɛ, bo ka joone yéh.
Juu chi Lod gɛ̀ bu Sodom, Nyo mo wu shiishɛ ŋgu we wu shiide wu bɛde nje muŋkaŋ, wu shii wu mo wu lɛɛshɛ bamii ba Sodom bachii.
Le gɛh no fi lé fi gê fi nyûme juu chi muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gê wu jâgɛ wu bunɛ.

Lé tô nyû abvu bwɛɛ, keefɛ muh wu le kigo ki yeh le, mwɛɛ mwe nyume yeh, ka wu shii ki wu lêe yeh lɛ wu jo fiɛɛ fì le yeh gɛ. Yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ tɛ, keefɛ muh wu le nchvuuŋ ka wu kwɛɛde ki wu tô wu jo fiɛɛ gɛ.
Bɛŋ kwâji fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ kooshɛ bɛ kwɛ Lod.
Muh wù goone ki wu bâji kinche ke lɛ keefɛ wu lɛsɛ gɛ, tu wu lé wu lɛ̂sɛ lo. Muh wù lɛsɛ kinche ke tu wu lé wu bâji lo kinche ke.
Nduu bɛŋ le lɛ, lé gê nyû kintaŋ kɛɛ le, bamii lé bo gê bo gîme fɛnta bafɛɛ, ba jo wu mumwaa wu mumwaa shɛɛ.
Bikɛse bafɛɛ lé bo gê bo gôge bvulɛɛŋ fɛ jɛɛŋ, ba jo wu mumwaa wu mumwaa shɛɛ.
[Bilɛŋsɛ bafɛɛ lé bo gê bo nyû mwɛne, ba jo wu mumwaa wumu shɛɛ.”]

content: Booŋ be ba ŋgoo biih wu le lɛ, “Tada, fiɛɛ fiyu lé fi gê fi kôoshɛ nyu faaŋ?” Wu chvuu nyu a ŋgaŋ le lɛ,

content.text: “Fɛ gvunɛ chi fiɛɛ to chi nyume fo le gɛh fo fɛ baŋgvuluŋ to bo taashi fo.”

footnotes.text: Kɛnɛ lɛ, “Bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le nyu a muntele mu bamii le.”
Gɛ baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme kinchiŋ kinɛ gɛ.
